note: Tracked streamdb performance baseline. Metrics are ns/op (lower is better). Recorded by the recurring streamdb-perf-benchmark discipline (ROI P1). The harness (scripts/streamdb-perf-benchmark.sh -> cargo run -p pillar-streamdb --example perf_bench --release) compares a fresh measurement against these values with a regression tolerance (STREAMDB_PERF_TOLERANCE, default 1.40 = allow 40% noise). A measurement worse than baseline*tolerance is a REGRESSION and fails the check unless a follow-up tuning task is filed. A measurement meaningfully BELOW baseline is headroom to record a new baseline. Update this file (and note it in the change doc) when a real, verified improvement lands.
